home.chat_web: Speak with the Castellana on the website
home.amuni_text:
Welcome, O traveler, to the edge of time,
where history breathes in every breath of wind.
Hear the call of ancient and severe stones,
guardians of tales, of ladies, of ancient prayers.

Do not stop your step, mirror yourself in this magic,
Amunì, come, I will show you the way.
home.castellana_intro_text: Speak with the Castellana: your multilingual tourist guide to discover stories, unpublished gems, and taste itineraries among the wonders of the village and the surrounding area.

citizen.intro_text: The beating heart of Amunì lies in those who live in the village every day. Guardians of ancient stories, handed-down flavors, and secrets hidden among the stones and alleys.
citizen.legends_desc: The oldest stories of the village, passed down from generation to generation.
citizen.legend_pizzarrone: The legend of the Pizzarrone Tower
citizen.audio_title: Listen to prayers and tales in dialect
citizen.castle_desc: A millenary fortress: conspiracies, loopholes, secret tunnels, prisons, and epic battles.
citizen.church_desc: A journey through catacombs, traditions, patrons, and ancient devotions.
citizen.food_desc: Authentic flavors, places to eat and experience the village.

castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.rhyme_1:
Welcome, O travelers, to the mighty manor,
that scans the valley and present history.
Perched proud on the mountain of living stone,
guardian of dreams, of glory, and mystery.
castle.rhyme_2:
Within these walls that defy time,
dynasties passed like a breath in the wind.
From the fierce, adventurous Chiaramonte,
every room tells of pacts and splendor.
castle.rhyme_3:
Do not look for dates in the cold volume,
but for the shadow dancing as the small light fades.
The Castellana awaits you, along the steps and the way,
to reveal the secret of Sister Felicia.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or do you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Just ask me.
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, with a dominant view over the valley.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and patrol walkways tell of its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble halls were the theater of medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still preserve the traces of ancient detentions.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for the love of a lady.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and suggestive internal halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.
castello.tickets: Full price € 6.00 | Reduced € 4.50 (Exclusively with online booking)

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is famous worldwide for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular service, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full price € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 years or with Castle ticket on the same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and works of sacred art that bear witness to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to St. George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece that dominates the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gaginiano school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to the rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visit Time Slots: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Set in the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and for the atmosphere of deep spirituality that can be breathed inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and worshipers.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sunday and Holidays visits in the slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the convent structure, the area offers an authentic insight into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village is home to no less than 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time hours and openings of lesser-known treasures such as the Church of San Rocco and other small widespread masterpieces.

chiese_page.poesia_intro:
Five temples of stone, of faith, and of memory,
open their doors to a centuries-old history.
chiese_page.verse_angeli:
At the Angeli rests, in the most sacred silence,
Blessed Giovanni, the simulacrum of the village.
chiese_page.verse_badia:
If you go down to the Badia, the earth turns to flower
in the majolica embroidery of rare splendor.
chiese_page.verse_duomo:
Enter the great Duomo, majestic and solemn,
among the marbles of Gagini and the perennial Stomer.
chiese_page.verse_annunziata:
Then the Annunziata reveals its painted vaults,
and the bell tower never conquered by guards.
chiese_page.verse_cappuccini:
Finally, climb to the Cappuccini, on the radiant hill,
between an altarpiece and a majestic panorama.
chiese_page.poesia_outro: Let yourself be guided where time has stopped...

transport_page.welcome: Welcome, O traveler, to the Transport section. Here you will find the necessary information to move your steps around the village.
transport_page.company_desc: The bus lines connect Caccamo to Termini Imerese and Palermo all year round. Taking advantage of the afternoon ride towards Palermo, it is possible to get off at Vetrana, a renowned seaside area. From Termini Imerese, you can also take the train to Cefalù and other tourist destinations.
transport_page.stop_1: Porta Euracea: in front of Bar Giallombardo and the building materials shop.
transport_page.stop_2: Viale Regione Siciliana: above the 'Roberta' playground (near the Axa insurance agency).
transport_page.stop_3: Piazza Cappuccini: under the shade of the ancient Convent.

events_page.title: Rituals and Festivals of the Village
events_page.intro: Experience the most authentic soul of our village through its centuries-old traditions, where faith, history, and folklore intertwine in unique and exciting moments.
events_page.signuruzzu_desc: On Palm Sunday, a local child portrays Jesus and rides on a harnessed donkey through the streets of the village decorated for the feast with palms. The procession stops in front of the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli and the Duomo of San Giorgio Martire for the suggestive blessing.
events_page.venerdi_desc: The atmosphere becomes profound with the altars set up in the churches for Good Friday, enriched with the typical dishes of wheat sprouted in the dark. The solemn and moving Procession and the town Via Crucis follow.
events_page.giovanni_desc: A deeply felt and experienced anniversary by the whole community, which gathers around its Blessed in an atmosphere of great devotion and popular warmth.
events_page.castellana_title: Election of the Castellana & Historical Parade
events_page.castellana_desc: The village dives back into its glorious medieval past. A majestic historical parade in period costumes crosses the streets, culminating with the solemn election of the Castellana of the manor.
events_page.nicasio_title: Feast of San Nicasio and the Palio
events_page.nicasio_desc: Vibrant celebrations in honor of the Saint, enriched by the highly anticipated and gripping town Palio that ignites the challenge and enthusiasm of young and old.
events_page.sagra_desc: Every year on October 12th, the scents of tradition invade the village. An unmissable gastronomic appointment to taste the authentic local sausage amidst songs, wine, and conviviality.
